prompt: What is a sensible first step in an ESXi networking investigation?
options: Identify the exact host and collect current read-only configuration evidence
Reset all switches before reading their settings
Delete management vmk0 immediately
Change every VLAN simultaneously
en: A current inventory narrows the problem without introducing unrelated changes.
ru: Current inventory unrelated changes ke baghair problem narrow karti hai.

prompt: What does TcpTestSucceeded: True for port 443 establish?
options: A TCP connection to that destination port succeeded
The ESXi login page definitely rendered
The user’s password is correct
Every management API call has passed
en: A TCP handshake is distinct from TLS, page loading and authentication.
ru: TCP handshake TLS, page loading aur authentication se alag hai.

prompt: What does a ping timeout prove by itself?
options: No ICMP reply arrived within the test period
The host is certainly powered off
Every TCP port is closed
The DNS record is definitely missing
en: ICMP may be filtered or unanswered even when another service is reachable.
ru: ICMP filtered ya unanswered ho sakti hai jab doosri service reachable ho.

prompt: What does an HTTP 301 response indicate?
options: A redirect to another URL/location
A successful ESXi administrator login
A measured network throughput result
An authoritative reverse DNS answer
en: A redirect response is not proof the destination page loaded or authenticated.
ru: Redirect response destination page load ya authentication ka proof nahin.

prompt: Which command inventories ESXi standard switches and uplinks?
options: esxcli network vswitch standard list
esxcli system shutdown poweroff
esxcli storage filesystem unmount
esxcli network ip dns server add
en: The list command inspects configuration without applying a switch change.
ru: List command switch change apply kiye baghair configuration inspect karti hai.

prompt: Which command displays assigned VMkernel IPv4 settings?
options: esxcli network ip interface ipv4 get
esxcli network nic get -n vmnic0
esxcli storage filesystem list
esxcli system hostname get
en: VMkernel addresses and physical-adapter link details are different data.
ru: VMkernel addresses aur physical-adapter link details alag data hain.

prompt: Which command checks ESXi IPv4 routing information?
options: esxcli network ip route ipv4 list
esxcli network vswitch standard portgroup list
esxcli network nic list
esxcli storage core adapter list
en: Routing information helps investigate off-subnet paths.
ru: Routing information off-subnet paths investigate karne mein madad karti hai.

prompt: What information should a useful test record preserve?
options: Actual command, source/destination, output, context and a justified conclusion
Only the expected answer copied from instructions
Only a screenshot title without host identity
Only the time the browser was opened
en: Evidence needs enough context to connect results to the tested path.
ru: Evidence mein itna context chahiye ke result tested path se connect ho.

prompt: Why keep local console access before changing management networking?
options: To recover if remote management is disconnected
To guarantee all guests have Internet access
To create a public DNS record automatically
To double every NIC’s reported bandwidth
en: Console recovery provides a path back when the remote network is broken.
ru: Remote network toot jaye to console recovery wapas access deti hai.

prompt: Which statement distinguishes an expected result from observed evidence?
options: Expected output is a prediction; observed output is what the actual test returned
They are interchangeable if the instructions look correct
Expected output proves every future run will pass
Only screenshots can be evidence; text output never can
en: Do not present predicted outcomes as measurements from the host.
ru: Predicted outcomes ko host ki actual measurements ke taur par pesh na karein.

prompt: You are checking desktop-esxi9. Which recorded management IP belongs to that context?
en: The ESXi8 .11 connection case is separate from ESXi9 .10.
ru: ESXi8 .11 connection case ESXi9 .10 se alag hai.

prompt: The Host Client opens by IP but not by host name. What is a focused comparison?
options: Check name resolution and client/browser proxy or name handling
Reformat the datastore immediately
Assume the physical NIC must be absent
Delete every VM port group
en: IP access working narrows attention to name-dependent behavior, without proving one root cause.
ru: IP access work kare to name-dependent behavior investigate hota hai, aik root cause prove nahin.

prompt: A Windows hosts mapping resolves a name for normal applications, but nslookup finds no DNS record. What can explain it?
options: Hosts-file resolution and direct DNS querying are different paths
nslookup must read SSH private keys first
The host cannot have a management IP
A successful application lookup proves public DNS has the record
en: A local mapping does not automatically create a DNS server record.
ru: Local mapping automatically DNS server record create nahin karti.

prompt: Which PowerShell lookup bypasses the Windows hosts file for a focused DNS-path check?
options: Resolve-DnsName desktop-esxi9 -Type A -DnsOnly -NoHostsFile
Get-Volume -DriveLetter C
Test-NetConnection 10.0.0.10 -Port 443
Get-Content C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts
en: The explicit NoHostsFile option separates this check from local hosts-file mappings.
ru: Explicit NoHostsFile option is check ko local hosts mappings se alag karti hai.

prompt: Which test checks the HTTPS TCP port directly using the ESXi9 management IP?
options: Test-NetConnection 10.0.0.10 -Port 443
nslookup desktop-esxi9
Get-Volume
en: The explicit IP and port test isolates that TCP connection attempt.
ru: Explicit IP aur port test us TCP connection attempt ko isolate karta hai.

prompt: You need to test the intended storage VMkernel path to a known peer. What should be selected?
options: The actual storage vmk interface and confirmed peer address
Always vmk0 regardless of the path
An interface number copied without checking current inventory
The guest’s DNS suffix instead of an interface
en: Interface-specific testing avoids accidentally using another host path.
ru: Interface-specific testing ghalti se doosra host path use karne se bachati hai.

prompt: A saved topology shows STORAGE/vmk1 and its IP. What remains separate verification?
options: Storage endpoint reachability and protocol/datastore I/O
Whether the shown object exists in that screenshot
Whether the label appears in the captured view
Whether the displayed vmk name can be read
en: Host network-object creation is not a storage-protocol completion test.
ru: Host network-object creation storage-protocol completion test nahin.

prompt: The lab notes have different uplink assignments at different times. What should precede a repeat change?
options: A current inventory reconciled with the historical checkpoints
Assume the oldest screenshot is the live final state
Assume every uncaptured intermediate change is known
Reset all adapters to guessed names
en: Historical observations do not replace current host inspection.
ru: Historical observations current host inspection ka badal nahin.

prompt: A failover exercise uses two same-host VMs on the same switch as ping endpoints. What evidence is still needed?
options: A path that actually traverses the tested uplink and its recovery during a fault
Only more local pings to the same peer
Only two adapters being listed Active
Only a label called REDUNDANT
en: Local traffic may bypass uplinks, so it cannot establish uplink failover.
ru: Local traffic uplinks bypass kar sakti hai; is se uplink failover establish nahin hota.

prompt: A shaping exercise reports only successful ping. Which evidence would assess the bandwidth policy?
options: Baseline, shaped and restored throughput measurements on the intended path
Only the VM’s static host name
Only the DNS SOA serial
Only a screenshot of disk capacity
en: Reachability and throughput are different questions.
ru: Reachability aur throughput alag sawal hain.

prompt: TCP 443 works but the browser still fails to show Host Client. Which checks are relevant?
options: HTTPS URL, TLS/certificate response, proxy/browser and management service behavior
Assume the user has already authenticated
Replace every VM’s IP immediately
Delete the secondary DNS zone as the first fix
en: A working TCP connection narrows but does not complete the application-layer diagnosis.
ru: Working TCP connection diagnosis narrow karti hai, application-layer diagnosis complete nahin.

prompt: A same-host guest ping works but an external peer fails. What should be investigated?
options: Uplink status, outer mapping, VLAN, addressing, routes and peer firewall
Assume local success proves external connectivity
Only the guest’s desktop resolution
Only whether the datastore is split into files
en: External traffic adds path components that local switching may not exercise.
ru: External traffic mein woh path components aate hain jo local switching test nahin karti.

prompt: A test-interface number in the notes does not exist on the current host. What is the next step?
options: Inventory actual interfaces and substitute the confirmed correct one
Create a new management interface blindly to match the number
Delete all interfaces with lower numbers
Assume the missing number is a DNS failure
en: Use real identifiers from the current system instead of forcing examples into place.
ru: Examples force karne ke bajaye current system ke actual identifiers use karein.

prompt: You need to remove an isolated practice network after testing. Which order is most sensible?
options: Restore test policies/links, detach dependent lab endpoints, then remove only unused lab interfaces/groups/switch
Delete management vmk0 before identifying lab objects
Delete every switch before moving any attached VM
Reset the whole network regardless of scope
en: Cleanup should follow dependencies and preserve pre-existing management/storage objects.
ru: Cleanup dependencies follow kare aur existing management/storage objects preserve kare.

prompt: An earlier browser timeout is followed by successful access without a captured root-cause test. What should the incident notes say?
options: Access succeeded later; the original timeout’s exact cause remains unconfirmed
DNS was definitely the cause because it is a networking issue
The physical cable definitely failed despite no link evidence
Every future access attempt is guaranteed to work
en: Resolution of a symptom and proof of its original cause are separate conclusions.
ru: Symptom resolve hona aur original cause ka proof alag conclusions hain.
